      public Media registerMedia(String url, int width, int height, long fileSize, UUID uploadedBy)
      Registers a new uploaded Media entity in the database.
      Parameters:
      url - physical URL of the uploaded file
      width - width of the image/video if applicable
      height - height of the image/video if applicable
      fileSize - size of the file in bytes
      uploadedBy - user UUID who uploaded the media
